title: Matterport3D: Learning from RGB-D Data in Indoor Environments
aliases: Matterport3D: Learning from RGB-D Data in Indoor Environments
publicationStatus: arXiv 预印本；正式发表状态未独立核实
summary: 提供楼宇级真实室内RGB-D、相机位姿、网格和语义，是多种导航/EQA任务的场景资产基础。

method.explanation: Matterport3D 通过楼宇内多个全景扫描站点获得配准RGB-D与相机姿态，生成重建网格并标注语义与区域。论文验证关键点匹配、视图重叠、法向估计和房间识别等任务。90建筑、10800全景、194400 RGB-D图像是不同层级，不能把扫描点数叫场景数；R2R或ObjectNav的episode和动作标注来自后续数据集。资产适合静态真实扫描场景研究，但不自带可移动家具动力学。
method.output: 场景网格、位姿、图像与语义资产
method.difference: 提供楼宇级真实室内RGB-D、相机位姿、网格和语义，是多种导航/EQA任务的场景资产基础。

table.caption: Table 2 : View overlap prediction results. Results on SUN3D and Matterport3D dataset measured by normalized discounted cumulative gain. From the comparison we can clearly see the performance improvement from training data with Matterport3D and from adding the extra overlap regression loss. We also note that overlap prediction is much harder in the Matterport3D dataset due to the wide baselines between camera poses.

analysis: 静态网格缺少对象运动和可交互动力学；原论文感知验证不是ObjectNav或VLN成绩。
